page_title: SUN 2-1 CHE | Sunderland v Chelsea 24/05/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+13' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+13' Sunderland take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90+11' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) has too much to say to the referee and receives a yellow card.
90+11' It looks like Joao Pedro (Chelsea) saw red with that tackle. Chris Kavanagh won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
90+8' Here comes a substitution. Christopher Rigg (Sunderland) is brought on as a substitute for Enzo Le Fee.
90+7' The foul by Joao Pedro (Chelsea) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Chris Kavanagh.
90+4' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
90+3' Josh Acheampong (Chelsea) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. Chelsea get a corner.
90+2' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) is adjudged offside.
90' 10 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Liam Delap (Chelsea) heads on.
89' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) gets booked for the first time in this match.
88' A pass lands at the feet of Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
88' Reece James (Chelsea) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Robin Roefs makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
86' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Chelsea.
85' Here is a change. Malo Gusto is going off and Calum McFarlane gives the last tactical orders to Josh Acheampong (Chelsea).
85' Substitution. Liam Delap (Chelsea) replaces Moises Caicedo.
81' This is a yellow card! Habib Diarra (Sunderland) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
79' Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
78' A precise low pass is received by Cole Palmer (Chelsea), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well over the bar.
75' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.
73' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) was quite harsh and Chris Kavanagh didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

72' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
71' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
69' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) sees a yellow card from Chris Kavanagh after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.

69' What a chance that is! Habib Diarra (Sunderland) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post.
68' Flag up against Noah Sadiki (Sunderland). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
65' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Pedro Neto walks off the pitch to be replaced by Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea).
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sunderland comes to nothing.

64' Habib Diarra (Sunderland) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sunderland.
62' Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle and Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
61' Regis Le Bris has decided to substitute Nilson Angulo and he is replaced by Habib Diarra (Sunderland).
61' The manager makes a subsitution with Wilson Isidor (Sunderland) coming on for Brian Brobbey.
61' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for an infringement.
60' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) sends a cross into the box, but Robin Roefs comes off his line to gather the ball.
59' Chance! Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) took a nice pass in his stride in the box, but scuffed his shot just wide of the left post.
56' 2 - 1 Goal! Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
55' A pass into the box finds Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) unmarked. He carefully places a shot towards the bottom left corner, but a brilliant last-ditch save by Robert Sanchez denies him.
54' Today's referee Chris Kavanagh rightly decides to book Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) for his harsh tackle.
53' The substitution is prepared. Reece James (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Jorrel Hato.
52' The ball falls kindly for Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) inside the box and he goes for goal. It's a decent effort but flies just wide of the right post.
51' Caution goes to Lutsharel Geertruida (Sunderland).
50' 2 - 0 This is definitely not what Malo Gusto (Chelsea) wanted. Attempting to intercept an offensive pass, he scored an own goal and made it 2:0.
47' The referee blows his whistle as Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) was too aggressive in his challenge.

46' Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a low strike towards the middle of the goal. Robert Sanchez guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
46' Referee Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Dangerous play by Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland). Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Trai Hume (Sunderland) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box and produces a poor effort that sails miles wide of the right post.
44' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
42' Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Chris Kavanagh didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
40' Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) tackles a bit over-zealously and Chris Kavanagh blows for a foul.

39' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Joao Pedro (Chelsea), whose header flies narrowly wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland will have a goal kick.
37' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) is penalised for holding. Chris Kavanagh signals a set piece.
36' Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
34' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
34' The free kick into the penalty area from Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) is cleared. The ball is out of play. Sunderland win a corner kick.
33' Levi Colwill (Chelsea) commits a rough challenge and Chris Kavanagh blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Good chance! Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored!
28' Chris Kavanagh couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) and blew his whistle.
25' 1 - 0 GOAL! A cross into the box is headed down by Luke O'Nien and Trai Hume (Sunderland) does brilliantly to get to the ball and fire home. 1:0.

21' Nilson Angulo (Sunderland) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Robert Sanchez sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the roof of the net.
20' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) has a great chance inside the box following a rebound off a defender, but somehow he gets too much on the ball and it goes well wide of the left post.
19' Luke O'Nien (Sunderland) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
19' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.
18' A long ball forward to Brian Brobbey (Sunderland) is intercepted. The ball goes out of play and Sunderland have been awarded a corner kick.
16' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
15' Noah Sadiki (Sunderland) was too forceful with his tackle and Chris Kavanagh interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Chelsea have a free kick.
13' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
12' Nordi Mukiele (Sunderland) strikes a volley towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders blocks his effort.
10' Sunderland enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
8' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) is penalised for a foul. Chris Kavanagh had a clear view and blows his whistle.
8' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) is about to take a corner kick.

7' Close! Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) picks up a pass and produces a ferocious strike towards the right post, but the goalkeeper gets his fingertips to the ball to keep it out. The ball goes out of play. Sunderland are awarded a corner kick.
5' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
4' Granit Xhaka (Sunderland) swings in a cross from the corner, but Robert Sanchez reads it well and gathers the ball.
3' Enzo Le Fee (Sunderland) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Good work from Sunderland as they win a corner.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Chelsea will take the kick-off.
Chris Kavanagh is introduced as the referee for today's match.
